clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Apothecary Helbrim studies the Barrens for the Royal Apothecary Society. Sent to Kalimdor, he gathers unfamiliar reagents for the Forsaken.

Apothecary Helbrim works beneath the harsh sun at the Crossroads, far from the Royal Apothecary Society's quarters in the damp undercity of Undercity. Sent across the Great Sea to Kalimdor, he searches the Barrens for useful plants, fungi, and other natural specimens. He depends on travelers to bring him samples, including local fungal spores, and works with Apothecary Zamah in Thunder Bluff. Through Helbrim, the Forsaken's alchemists reach beyond the ruined borders of Lordaeron.
